description:
Apply the dense-parity adoption decision through the existing `BitMatrix::matvec` and isolated SIMD kernel boundary.

## Background

When no candidate qualifies, this issue verifies that the fused AND-popcount production path remains unchanged and records that disposition. A qualifying change is limited to its declared route, retains scalar fallback, and cannot relabel the already selected fusion as new work.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The selected outcome is reflected exactly in production code, or the no-adoption decision leaves `matvec` behavior and selection unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-02: Shared scalar/SIMD suites prove exact outputs for empty, aligned, offset, and 0/1/63/64/65 boundary cases with canonical indexing and zero tails.
- [hard] REQ-03: Any unsafe intrinsic code stays in `gf2-kernels-simd` with an explicit safety contract, annotated release assembly is committed for modified SIMD symbols, and Rust 1.95 builds the affected path.

## Notes

Before/after performance confirmation is intentionally separate from this code change.
title: Implement the selected dense-parity outcome
